pictures.name: straight_clean_path_over_grass
pictures.scene: one clear straight footpath running away over open green grass without a bend or a break in it, the near track lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the country and sky above it pale and calm

pictures.name: well_laid_stone_pavement
pictures.scene: a paved way of squared stones laid close and level and true, the nearest slabs lit warm and hard along the bottom of the frame, the paving beyond them running away dim and even and quite unbroken

pictures.name: sealed_jar_kept_on_a_shelf
pictures.scene: a plain clay jar sealed with wax and set carefully back on a stone shelf, the jar lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the wall and the shelf above it dim and rough and altogether bare

pictures.name: lamp_carried_along_a_dark_wall
pictures.scene: one small lamp moving along beside a long stone wall at night and lighting only what is nearest, the wall and floor lit warm and low, the dark above and ahead of it deep and quiet and unlit

pictures.name: unmarked_snow_on_a_track
pictures.scene: a hill track under a smooth fall of clean new snow with nothing trodden across it, the near snow lit warm and faintly gold at the bottom of the frame, the slope and sky above it pale and still

pictures.name: plumb_line_hanging_true
pictures.scene: a weighted cord hanging perfectly straight and still against a rising stone wall, the plumb weight lit warm and hard low in the frame, the wall behind and above it plain and dim and evenly built

pictures.name: wheel_rut_running_true
pictures.scene: a pair of deep cart ruts worn dead straight into a dry track, the nearest ruts lit warm and hard at the bottom of the frame, the way beyond them running out flat and pale toward the horizon

pictures.name: open_ground_with_nothing_hidden
pictures.scene: a wide swept expanse of bare level ground standing in clear even daylight with nothing at all upon it, the near dust lit warm and low, the empty land and sky above it flat and pale and open

pictures.name: true_set_cornerstone
pictures.scene: one large dressed cornerstone set exactly square at the foot of a new wall, its cut edges lit warm and hard at the bottom of the frame, the courses rising above it plain and dim and true

pictures.name: small_lamp_burning_on_a_sill
pictures.scene: a small clay lamp left burning steadily on a deep stone window sill, its flame and the sill lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the night beyond the opening deep and blue and quiet

lines.text: Blessed are those whose way is blameless,
who walk in the Law of the LORD.
Blessed are those who keep His testimonies
and seek Him with all their heart.
that we should keep them diligently.
Oh, that my ways were committed
Then I would not be ashamed
when I consider all Your commandments.
I will praise You with an upright heart
when I learn Your righteous judgments.
